children: Global Water Resources entered into an Eighth Modification Agreement to amend its revolving credit facility with Northern Trust. The amendment increases borrowing capacity from $20 million to $30 million and extends the maturity date to August 30, 2028. If the company completes any capital markets activity after the amendment date, the maximum availability will adjust to $25 million. The changes are intended to enhance liquidity and support ongoing corporate needs.
: Amendment to revolving line of credit
